channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Panera Bread: BOGO $5 Entree with Code BOGO5
item.guid: Panera Bread-BOGO $5 Entree with Code BOGO5-2026-08-13
item.description: Use promo code BOGO5 at online or in-app checkout to get a second whole sandwich, whole salad, bowl of soup, market bowl, or mac and cheese for only $5. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera Bread: Mix and Match $4.99 Half-Portions
item.description: Build a meal from up to 10 half-portion menu items including soups, sandwiches, and salads at $4.99 each, saving roughly 40% off regular prices with one included side. (Ongoing)

item.title: Wingstop: $24.99 Flavor Lineup Bundle for 3-4
item.description: Order online or in the app and choose a Flavor Lineup of traditional wings in up to four flavors including Lemon Pepper, Hot Honey Rub, Mango Habanero, and more, plus a large fry and large ranch — feeds three to four people. (Limited time)

item.title: Shake Shack: $4 Crinkle Cut Fries In-App
item.guid: Shake Shack-$4 Crinkle Cut Fries In-App-2026-08-13
item.description: Order through the Shake Shack mobile app or website to score Crinkle Cut Fries for $4 — no promo code needed, available any day at participating locations chain-wide. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Chili’s: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili’s-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-13
item.description: Chili’s all-day 3 For Me bundles a bottomless drink, an appetizer (chips and salsa or house salad), and a full entree starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers - every day at participating locations, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
